messages.subject: ggplot not picking up variable
parts:
Not sure if this is a Shiny problem but would appreciate some assistance
I am looking to add a vertical line to a plot which includes the following code
stGame will normally depend on previous calculations in the function
but I have hardcoded for simplicity

output$plot <- reactivePlot() {
...
stGame <- "1997-08-09"
print(stGame) # [1] "1997-08-09"

print(
     ggplot() etc. + 
       geom_vline(aes(xintercept=as.numeric(as.POSIXct(endGame))))
     )
})
Error in as.POSIXct(stGame) : object 'stGame' not found

If I declare stGame <- "1997-08-09" outside of the function in,say, global.R the line gets drawn correctly

As an alternative, I tried putting the calculations to produce the data for the plot in a separate reactive function but 
had other problems with that

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: ggplot not picking up variable
parts:
Hi Andrew -

(I'm assuming that you want to use `stGame` where you've put `endGame` in your code.)
This is due to a bug in ggplot2 where it evaluates the call to aes() in the global environment, instead of the calling environment, which is what you'd normally expect. Here's the bug in the tracker:
  https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/743

A couple workarounds.
- In the call to ggplot(), specify the environment:
    ggplot(..., environment = environment())

- In the geom_vline(), don't put the xintercept in aes() -- just get rid of the aes() completely. (geom_vline and geom_hline are a special cases of how they use aes.)


-Winston
